messages_status_direction_check.name: messages_status_direction_check
messages_status_direction_check.value: ("messages"."direction" = 'inbound' AND "messages"."status" IS NULL) OR ("messages"."direction" = 'outbound' AND "messages"."status" IS NOT NULL)

messages_single_sender_check.name: messages_single_sender_check
messages_single_sender_check.value: NOT ("messages"."sent_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."flow_run_id" IS NOT NULL)
